$comment: The institution registry: every deployment this system is allowed to drive.
This exists because the CLI used to import its institution list from
target-app/data.ts - the mock application's own module, whose TenantConfig
carries accent colours, DOM id prefixes and the label vocabulary used to
*render* the fixture. None of that means anything for a real target, and
an institution that is not the fixture could not be expressed at all.
That was genuine coupling to the original target, and it is the one place
the adaptation found any. The fix is a registry the system owns: four
fields, no code, no rebuild. Onboarding institution number 2,001 is an
entry in this file plus an origin in policy.yaml.
baseUrl: an absolute URL, or a path beginning with / which is resolved
against the local fixture app (TARGET_APP_PORT). product/productVersion
identify the VENDOR BUILD, not the institution - that is what makes one
recording reusable across every institution running the same software.
